scope: Recover one exact historical documentation checkpoint through the existing reviewed registry, preserving the original commit and all normal validation.
riskAnalysis: Only the exact079ee41 commit, one regular path, exact before/after blob digest and fixed supplemental plan hash qualify. No generic fallback, owner authority, source mutation permission or missing-plan exception is introduced. Retrospective evidence is not a historical CI success.

threatModel.assets: Immutable checkpoint history, engineering plan validation, complete CI ancestry and current source/release identity.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Reviewed code-owned exact recovery pin versus arbitrary caller/history/plan content; retrospective documentation versus execution authority.
threatModel.abuseCases: Substitute another commit or blob/path, add code to documentation recovery, forge or edit supplement, downgrade risk, use symlink/executable file or suppress duplicate matching records.
threatModel.mitigations: Existing exact registry/hash/regular-file checks, unchanged ordinary plan/proactive validation, additive single pin and complete negative matrix; old pins unchanged.

defects.rootCause: Prior documentation checkpoint079ee41 omitted its source-bound plan; the immediate-parent check on later preparation did not scan that historical gap.
defects.detectionGap: Local preflight used the latest parent while CI scans the full PR base ancestry.
defects.regression: 39 recovery tests cover exact pin and altered commit/blob/path/file modes/plan identity/content/duplicates; run full-main-base preflight before push.
defects.historicalPrevention: Always create the checkpoint plan in the same documentation commit and run full PR-history preflight locally before publishing.

rollback: Do not rewrite historical commits. Revert the new registry pin through reviewed source changes if its facts fail verification; leave original CI failure and documentation evidence intact.
